cost_drag_proportional_to_actual_scale.assumption: multiply each unchanged registered sleeve drag by the sleeve's actual causal scaling factor

financing_notional_includes_inner_sleeve.assumption: retain locked sleeve returns and costs; funded P3 notional is outer_scale * (1 + 0.5 * P1_scale + 0.5 * P2_scale) - 1

metadata.annual_cost_conversion: locked primary divides annual drag by 12 and deducts it once after sleeve scaling
metadata.rolling_window_dependence: 60-month windows overlap by 59 months and are not independent
metadata.slice_language: 2010+ was untouched by this run only; it was not unknown when the ideas were selected or in the finance literature
metadata.trend_splice: AQR original through 2009-12; AQR current extension from 2010-01

promotion_gate: No candidate may reach main or live money before a frozen 6-12 month paper-forward record passes its registered gate.

protocol_audit.rule: Every primary series used by a candidate must begin at the frozen 1991-01 common start; a later start is DATA_INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.
